holes.invalid: Invalid preview tunnel. Check the name (1-128 characters), the Runner host, the port (1-65535) and the validity period.
holes.changed: This preview tunnel changed. Reload before saving.
holes.revoked: This preview tunnel has been revoked and can no longer be changed.
holes.notActive: Only an active preview tunnel can be checked.
holes.runnerUpgrade: This Runner does not support preview tunnels yet. Upgrade the Runner.
holes.connectionUnsupported: Preview tunnels only work with Runner-connected hosts.
holes.notFound: This preview link does not exist, has expired or has been revoked.
holes.unavailable: The previewed service cannot be reached: the Runner is offline or the local port is not accepting connections.
holes.busy: This preview has too many open connections. Try again shortly.
holes.timeout: The previewed service did not respond in time.
holes.tooLarge: The request body exceeds the 64 MiB preview limit.
holes.automatic: This preview is managed by a pipeline or workflow. It can only be revoked.
holes.reviewClosed: This preview is not waiting for review.
holes.notReady: The local service did not become reachable in time: {detail}
holes.entryInvalid: Invalid preview ingress configuration. Check the enabled scheme, IP addresses and port range.
holes.entryRisk: Explicitly acknowledge public access before using this scheme. Automatic public previews require separate administrator approval.
holes.entryBind: Cannot bind the preview listener. Check the local IP and permissions.
holes.entryPorts: No free port is available in the configured preview range.
holes.entryBinary: Cannot start cloudflared. Check its executable path and permissions on this server node.
holes.entryUnavailable: The preview ingress is unavailable. Check the connector and network, then retry explicitly.
holes.entryTimeout: The temporary tunnel did not become ready within 45 seconds. The original ingress was kept.
holes.targetNotPrivate: The target must be this Runner host or an address on its local network (loopback, 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 100.64/10 or IPv6 ULA). Public, link-local and cloud metadata addresses are not allowed.
holes.targetInvalid: Enter an IP address or host name without scheme, port or path.
holes.targetRunnerUpgrade: Forwarding to a LAN address needs Runner 0.5.0-alpha or later on this host. Upgrade the Runner, or leave the target empty to use this host's own port.
holes.macLocalNetwork: macOS may be blocking the HostAgent from the local network: in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network, allow ferry-runner. If it isn't listed, reinstall the HostAgent for the current user.
holes.targetSchemeInvalid: The target protocol must be HTTP or HTTPS.
holes.insecureNeedsHttps: Allowing an untrusted certificate only applies to HTTPS targets.
holes.tlsUntrusted: The target's HTTPS certificate is not trusted ({detail}). For a device with a self-signed certificate (such as PVE or a NAS), turn on "Allow insecure certificate" for this preview.
holes.tlsPlainHttp: The target answered with plain HTTP, not HTTPS. Set the target protocol to HTTP.
holes.tlsHandshake: The HTTPS connection to the target could not be established: {detail}
